label: sec:planck-info-unit
html: The local Planck length \ell_P^{\mathrm{step}}(p) defines the minimal quantisable size of an information unit at a point p \in M. It scales with the substrate parameter as \ell_P^{\mathrm{step}} \sim \hbar_q --- the fraction of one Reeb circuit traversed per Planck step, not the circuit itself (see share versus total).
